title: CreateExportReportRequestByPartner

report_type.description: The type of report to generate.

report_columns.description: The columns to include in the report. This can be a subset of the columns available for the specified report type. To request all columns, specify all available columns.

merchant_ids.description: The merchant IDs to include in the report. You may provide Grubhub merchant IDs or Partner external IDs if there is a configured mapping to Grubhub merchant IDs. Partners enabled for external IDs can only pass in external IDs.

report_name.description: The name for the generated CSV report file. This field is optional. If left blank, a name will be generated using the specified parameters.

description: The request body for requesting a report.

DateRange.description: Date range for the report using a start and end date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

ReportRequestParametersByPartner.description: The parameters to request the report. Currently, the only supported parameter is date range.
